notes.title: Race of Life Act 1 - hotfix v1.04.5
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’ve just fixed an issue that was affecting access to saves made before the last hotfix. The good news is: your pre-update saves [b]SHOULD[/b] now work again! 🎉If we didn't f*ck something up in the process, that is.

[b]However, we also want to be honest with you — this fix may have caused some saves made after April 10th (in specific scenes) to no longer function correctly. We’re really sorry about that. 😔[/b]

Over the past few days, we’ve been working hard to understand and solve this issue. Unfortunately, it was something out of our control — it’s a rare problem that can occur with the engine we use to build the game. This was our first time encountering it too.

We truly hope this won't happen in future updates, but we can’t promise it won’t — though we’ll do everything we can to prevent it.

Also, good news: we might have fixed the issue where the walkthrough wasn’t launching properly. If you had trouble with that before, please give it another try after this update and let us know if it works for you!

We're really sorry for the inconvenience, and we hope those of you who started new saves recently will understand the situation. [b]If you need to replay the game from the beginning, take use of the skip function. You can also turn on "Skip the unseen" option in settings - it'll speed up the process even more.[/b]

Thanks so much for your support and patience!

notes.content: I uploaded a simple hotfix that fixes some typos and a few bugs in Chinese version, mainly game crash in the parking lot scene with Veronica.

notes.title: Race of Life is Now Live on Steam! 🏁🎮
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44563870/bec148d29bba22f7b3012e440de3ac6d57ae08f9.png[/img]

[h3]We’re thrilled to announce that [i]Race of Life Act 1[/i] is officially [b]live on Steam[/b] and ready for you to play! [/h3]
While we’ve thoroughly tested the game, with so many possible paths, there’s always a chance you might encounter a bug. If you do, please don’t hesitate to let us know – we’ll do our best to address any issues as quickly as possible. 🛠️

[b]For our Russian-speaking players:[/b] the Russian translation is finished and currently in testing. As soon as it’s 100% playable, we’ll release an update for the game. We hope this happens as soon as possible, and we deeply apologize for not being able to include it at launch. Thank you for your patience!

We also have plans for two simple DLCs coming soon!
1️⃣[i] A walkthrough guide[/i] (PDF) to help you explore all the different ways to play the game.
2️⃣[i] A wallpaper pack[/i] featuring 50 stunning wallpapers of the characters from the game.
These weren’t ready in time for launch, but they’ll be available as soon as Steam gives us the green light. 🎉

Enjoy the game and good luck on the track! 🏎️💨
